description: This file contains unit tests for the ScreenController class in an iOS application, focusing on WebView configuration, navigation, JavaScript evaluation, URL trust validation, and A2UI action parsing.

methods.name: mountScreen
methods.description: Sets up a ScreenController instance with a WebView coordinator for testing purposes.

methods.name: canvasModeConfiguresWebViewForTouch
methods.description: Verifies WebView configuration for touch input mode.

methods.name: navigateEnablesScrollForWebPages
methods.description: Checks that navigation to a URL enables scrolling in the WebView.

methods.name: navigateSlashShowsDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Ensures that navigating to '/' results in an empty URL string.

methods.name: evalExecutesJavaScript
methods.description: Tests JavaScript execution and result retrieval with a timeout.

methods.name: trustedRemoteA2UIURLMustMatchExactly
methods.description: Validates that URLs trusted for remote A2UI actions match exactly, ignoring fragments.

methods.name: genericNavigationClearsTrustedRemoteA2UIURL
methods.description: Ensures that navigation away from a trusted URL clears the trust state.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBodyAcceptsJSONString
methods.description: Checks that JSON string bodies are correctly parsed into action objects.
